finding.text: Requirement 4 asks for a 1920 shot "showing both demos with their tab bars", but the shot shows only the first demo (shots/127-0-0-1-62645-framework-ext-tabs/1920.png, viewport ends below demo 1). The `block` demo (/tabs-demo-block/) is not shown, so its fix is unproven by the shots; only the session log's `data-demo-url` values vouch for it.

Both demo panels render empty under the selected "what" tab (sheet.png, 1920 and 400, demo box below the tab bar): the md text "This panel is a real page..." is not visible. Blank may be the fixed 10em height clipping, or the child not mounting; the owner cannot tell from the shot that the tab content works.

The demo tab links carry `data-demo-url` and no `href` (session.jsonl "After" line). That matches the demo box's design, but "link to real urls" is met only as data attributes, not as clickable hrefs.

The change adds a second `mark` call (tabs.js `this.app?.mark?.()`) beside `router.mark_links()`. It is one line, but the comment names a demo case inside the real-page tabs code path, so a real page whose `app` has a `mark` would also run it.

Smoke after: 3 FAIL remain in the three-page set (Panel text touching, two sessions ?tab=coverage links from Doc). The log says none are in ext/tabs and Panel failed before; I could not verify this from the shots.
